name: Videola
description: A video editor that runs in the browser: import, cut, keyframe, grade, mix and export, with the project model and the command bus in a Rust core compiled to WebAssembly. This container serves the editor, an HTTP API and an MCP server for agents from one Node process. Set a token. Every /api call needs it as an Authorization: Bearer header, and the server refuses to bind anything but loopback without one. Projects and media live in the /data volume. That is the directory to include in a backup.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Projects and imported media. The one path worth backing up.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: The port the editor and the API answer on.

variables.name: API token
variables.description: Required. Every /api call carries it as `Authorization: Bearer token`, and the server will not listen on a reachable address without one. Generate one with: openssl rand -hex 24

variables.name: Interface language
variables.description: `en` or `de`. What the server writes into generated names and messages; the editor itself follows the browser.

variables.name: Open projects at once
variables.description: How many projects the server keeps open in memory. Each one holds its own core instance.
